mainEntity.name: What steps should I take to prepare my home for an exterior renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an exterior renovation project begins, you should take several preparatory steps to ensure a smooth process. This includes clearing the work area of outdoor furniture, plants, and decorations, and ensuring easy access for equipment and materials. If the project involves roofing or siding, it's wise to protect interior items near exterior walls from potential dust or vibrations. Communicating any concerns about pets or children with our team beforehand also helps us maintain a safe and efficient work environment. We'll provide a pre-construction checklist for your specific project.
